mapLabel: World map. Use arrow keys to move and + or − to zoom.
noPlaces: No countries or cities found. Try another name.
populationDescription: Draw one or more boundaries to estimate population in the area. The map center is not counted.
populationCitySearchInstructions: Choose a city to identify its country and search for an ADM2 boundary. If none is available, you can draw the area.
populationBoundaryNotFound: No ADM2 unit matched that name. You can draw the area manually.
populationBoundaryUnavailable: No ADM2 layer is available for this country. You can draw the area manually.
populationBoundarySearchFailed: This boundary could not be searched or queried. Try again or draw the area.
populationBoundaryOutlineOmitted: The boundary outline is not shown on the map; the calculation uses the full administrative unit.
populationBoundaryOutlineSimplified: The map outline is simplified for display only; the estimate uses the full administrative boundary.
drawInstructions: Click to add corners; close the polygon to finish. Press Escape to cancel.
areaRequired: Draw a complete area before calculating.
invalidArea: This boundary is invalid. It is preserved so you can edit or redraw it.
areaTooLarge: The area exceeds the query limit. Draw a smaller area or select an administrative unit.
populationNoCoverage: Population data is unavailable for this area; this does not mean zero people.
populationPartialCoverage: The area includes a territory without data. No total was calculated.
populationMethod: WorldPop 2025 estimate; 100 m cells measured in people per cell.
populationSamplingMethod: A cell contributes its full value when its center is inside the area; otherwise it is excluded, even if the boundary crosses part of it. Water is excluded only when the source marks it as NoData. The raster uses geographic coordinates (EPSG:4326), and area is calculated geodesically.
populationSmallAreaResolution: This area is smaller than a nominal 100 m grid cell; the figure is a grid-resolution estimate, not a street-by-street count.
populationDataGaps: The total sums only cells with data; it does not represent the entire area.
populationQueryFailed: Population could not be calculated. Try again.
populationTooManyCountries: The area spans too many countries for one query. Draw a smaller area.
invalidQuery: Enter a country or city using 2 to 160 characters, without control characters.
searchTimeout: The search took too long. Try again.
searchFailed: The search could not be completed. Try again.
searchQuota: The search limit has been reached. Wait a moment and try again.
searchUnavailable: The catalogue could not be queried. Search again or choose a location on the map.
cardFailed: The record could not be opened. Choose another scenario or try again.
invalidCoordinates: Longitude must be between −180 and 180; latitude between −90 and 90.
latitudeCoverage: Local detail is unavailable at this latitude. The location is retained and the global view is shown.
mapFailed: Part of the map could not be loaded. Try again.
graphicsLost: The map lost access to graphics. Try again.
graphicsUnavailable: The map could not be opened. Try again with WebGL2 graphics available.
metadataDescription: Explore the world and view documented events.
beirutDescription: An explosion occurred in the port of Beirut, Lebanon, on 4 August 2020.
beirutSource: UN — Explosion in the port of Beirut (4 August 2020)
nuclearDescription: The International Committee of the Red Cross describes the humanitarian consequences of using nuclear weapons.
nuclearSource: ICRC — Frequently asked questions about nuclear weapons
infoExplore: Explore countries, cities and streets. Use the zoom controls or scroll wheel; drag to move the map.
infoKeyboard: Tab moves through controls. Arrow keys move the map when it has focus. Choose location lets you enter coordinates. Escape or Back closes the panel.
infoMap: Map detail varies by region. Local detail is unavailable beyond ±85.0511° latitude.
infoSearch: Countries and cities include alternative names and regions. Small settlements may be missing.
countryNameFallback: If no published name is available in the selected language, a local or English name is retained; official street names are not translated.
disclaimerData: Mapa Táctico provides maps and contextual information. Geographic data may be incomplete or outdated. Visual scale does not establish data accuracy.
disclaimerHistory: Historical information retains its sources. An area's population count is not a prediction of injuries or deaths. The portal does not replace official warnings or emergency decisions.
disclaimerMilitary: Military and nuclear events are covered through historical and humanitarian information. The portal does not calculate attacks on real locations.
disclaimerMap: Map queries transmit the tiles required for the current view.
disclaimerSearch: The search uses a catalogue hosted on Sites. The application does not store profiles or individual queries; its quota uses a global counter. Sites and map providers process technical request data according to their policies.
countryOriginal: This name is retained from the original catalog; no verified translation is available.
keyboardDrawingInstructions: You can also enter longitude and latitude for each vertex. Add at least three, then choose Use these vertices.
